notes.title: New Patch1.1
notes.content:
[b]New Feature
[/b]

[olist]
[*] Your damage will be enhanced for a while when you draw your blade. That will not cost energy

[*] Enemy will drop item to use. The Red Donkey will refill your energy. Orange restore your HP, meanwhile, did orange remind you some thing? Try to slash it!

[*] The StunPoint and Stun Condition system now available. You can reduce the SP of the enemy by block or attack.

[*] Normal attack can slash the enemy now. The damage should be exceeding the threshold. So the draw enhance and Stun Condition should be useful.

[*] The Shuriken now can be reflex back to the enemy. Come on Genji.

[*] Some enemy may counter your attack.
[/olist]

[b]Bugfixs and Modding[/b]

[list]
[*] The knock away attack now has a limit.

[*] Dash nolonger cost energy now.

[*] Improved some anmations

[/list]
===============================================================

Boss level is already finished！

It will be released soon，very soon！

notes.title: patch in 12.31
notes.content:
The combat difficulty is adjusted. You will not block every enemy attack by the sheath，damage can still be prevented but maybe you will be knock away, and not all the enemy move could be interrupted.

The energy will recover harder. choose a good time for your slash。

Some bug is fixed.
